newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade thin at $66.50 -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade thin at $66.50 -USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady to $0.50 per cwt higher.

Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 4,100 slaughter steers and 2,900 heifers; 93,900 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 18,300 formulated and 1,300 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 66.00-66.50. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 66.00-66.50.
Confirmed - 7,000 Week ago - None Year ago - 10,400
Wk to Date - 93,900 Week ago - 77,700 Year ago - 80,900
